texts.title: Dressing in layers for winter walks

paragraphs.text: For walking in cold weather, experts recommend several thin layers rather than one thick coat. Layers trap warm air between them and can be removed if you get too hot.
The layer next to the skin, called the base layer, should draw sweat away from the body. Wool and synthetic fabrics do this well, while cotton stays wet and makes you cold.
Over this goes a mid layer, such as a fleece, which provides most of the warmth. The outer layer, or shell, should be windproof and waterproof but allow moisture to escape.

Heat is quickly lost from the head and hands, so a hat and gloves are essential, and thick socks help to keep the feet warm. Walkers should also carry a spare layer in their bag in case the weather changes.
Finally, walkers should tell someone where they are going and when they expect to return, particularly in remote areas.

items.quote: The layer next to the skin, called the base layer

explanation.en: “The layer next to the skin, called the base layer” → base. “Layer” is already in the label.
explanation.kk: «The layer next to the skin, called the base layer» → base. «Layer» жазуда тұр.
explanation.ru: «The layer next to the skin, called the base layer» → base. «Layer» уже в подписи.

items.quote: should draw sweat away from the body

explanation.en: “should draw sweat away from the body” → sweat. “Moisture” in paragraph 3 is about the outer layer.
explanation.kk: «should draw sweat away from the body» → sweat. 3-абзацтағы «moisture» сыртқы қабатқа қатысты.
explanation.ru: «should draw sweat away from the body» → sweat. «Moisture» из абзаца 3 относится к внешнему слою.

items.quote: Over this goes a mid layer, such as a fleece

explanation.en: The text gives an example of a mid layer: “such as a fleece”. “e.g.” = “such as”, so the answer is fleece.
explanation.kk: Мәтіндегі ортаңғы қабаттың мысалы: «a mid layer, such as a fleece». Жазудағы «e.g.» = «such as», жауап fleece.
explanation.ru: Пример среднего слоя в тексте: «a mid layer, such as a fleece». «e.g.» в подписи = «such as», ответ fleece.

items.quote: The outer layer, or shell, should be windproof and waterproof

explanation.en: “The outer layer, or shell” → shell. The “coat” in paragraph 1 is what experts advise against.
explanation.kk: «The outer layer, or shell» → shell. 1-абзацтағы «coat» — ұсынылмайтын нәрсе.
explanation.ru: «The outer layer, or shell» → shell. «Coat» из абзаца 1 — то, чего советуют избегать.

items.quote: a hat and gloves are essential

explanation.en: “a hat and gloves are essential” → hat. “Socks” are for the feet, and the label pairs it with gloves.
explanation.kk: «a hat and gloves are essential» → hat. «Socks» — аяққа, ал жазуда қолғап тұр.
explanation.ru: «a hat and gloves are essential» → hat. «Socks» — для ног, в подписи стоят перчатки.
